metrics.name: delay_time
metrics.description: Total stopping time: number of steps to reach 1 using combined steps ((3n+1)/2 for odd, n/2 for even)

metrics.name: glide_time
metrics.description: Number of combined steps until trajectory first drops below starting value

metrics.name: max_excursion
metrics.description: Highest value reached during trajectory from n to 1

metrics.name: compression_ratio
metrics.description: Ratio of bit-length of n to delay time. Lower = more 'efficient' trajectory

verification_protocol.description: Given (n, claimed_delay), compute delay_time(n) and check equality. Also compute glide_time, max_excursion for completeness.
